import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")

# 1. Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].value_counts().head(10)
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 10)
bars = ax1.barh(range(len(breed_counts)), breed_counts.values, color=colors)
ax1.set_yticks(range(len(breed_counts)))
ax1.set_yticklabels(breed_counts.index)
ax1.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Top 10 Most Popular Dog Breeds in Zurich', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.invert_yaxis()
for i, v in enumerate(breed_counts.values):
    ax1.text(v + 50, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 2. Dog Age Distribution
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
# Filter out any invalid age data and get unique dog ages
age_data = df[df['AlterVHundNum'].notna() & (df['AlterVHundNum'] >= 0) & (df['AlterVHundNum'] <= 25)]
age_counts = age_data.groupby('AlterVHundNum')['AnzHunde'].sum()
ax2.bar(age_counts.index, age_counts.values, color='steelblue', alpha=0.7, edgecolor='navy')
ax2.set_xlabel('Dog Age (Years)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution of Dogs in Zurich', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_xlim(-0.5, 20.5)

# 3. Dogs by District (Kreis)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
district_counts = df.groupby('KreisLang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
colors3 = sns.color_palette("viridis", len(district_counts))
ax3.barh(district_counts.index, district_counts.values, color=colors3)
ax3.set_xlabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Dog Population by District (Kreis)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(district_counts.values):
    ax3.text(v + 20, i, str(v), va='center', fontsize=9)

# 4. Dog Gender Distribution with Owner Age Groups
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create a cross-tabulation of dog gender and owner age
gender_age = df.groupby(['SexHundLang', 'AlterV10Lang'])['AnzHunde'].sum().unstack(fill_value=0)
# Select the most common age groups
age_order = df.groupby('AlterV10Lang')['AnzHunde'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False).head(6).index.tolist()
gender_age_filtered = gender_age[[col for col in age_order if col in gender_age.columns]]
gender_age_filtered.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, colormap='Set2', edgecolor='black', width=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Dog Gender', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Dog Gender by Owner Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.legend(title='Owner Age Group', bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1), loc='upper left', fontsize=8)
ax4.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Dog Registration Analysis in Zurich, Switzerland', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
